methods.label: Distribute the product across the fractions
methods.explanation:
The product \(2\cdot3\cdot4=24\) is divisible by each denominator. Distributing \(24\) across the three fractions therefore turns each term into a whole number:
\[
\begin{aligned}
24\left(\frac12+\frac13+\frac14\right)
&=\frac{24}{2}+\frac{24}{3}+\frac{24}{4}\\
&=12+8+6=26.
\end{aligned}
\]
The value is \(26\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
